en: Oops... sorry. But you'd best steer clear
of anything dangerous, eh? Take my advice.
Hey, how're you doing?
Seeing you mixed in with the crowd is
getting to be a regular thing. Heh heh.
Me, I'm just a two-bit entertainer for now.
But someday I really want to make it big.
Whoa... Something I can do for you?
Off the job, I'm just a regular guy with dreams.
I do my act in the square on the main street.
I'm pretty good, if I say so myself. Come watch!
Oh, it's you. Come to the main street.
At home, all I do is eat and sleep, y'know.
Oh,
, my good sir!
What's up? I don't do my act at home, y'know.
, my good sir.
Need something? 'Cause I don't need a thing.
Wanna come in? Stay and chat a while.
Not that I've got anything. I'm broke, see!
, it's you.
You sure like visiting people's homes, huh?
Well, whatever. I'm a bachelor myself.
It gets lonely sometimes, y'know. Thanks.
Well, hello! Haven't seen you around, mate.
Good afternoon. ...And you are?
I'm Jeremy, a juggler.
Brightening up drab streets with my act, that's my job.
note: must end in 'my job': #11 'And getting yelled at by coppers is, too.' follows

en: Ha ha ha, you're an amusing fellow...
That's right, making folks laugh's my mission!
I'll do that, if I have the time.
Come to the main street.
I'll always be waiting for you!
...Or is that creepy, coming from a guy?
While you're in London, don't you miss
my act, or you'll be sorry!
And tips are always welcome, any time!
I see. So you're a street performer. How fun.
What, mate, fallen for me or something?
Have you been following me? Ha ha, kidding.
Prove it with a tip tomorrow, by day!

note: shared '!' (34 uses); msg 258971 gets its space from the #380 variant ' Good evening.'

en: Hey, how's it going? Drop by now and then, eh?
<Yes, actually...>
<No, not really>
Well, not that it's any of my business.
Thank you. It's kind of you to worry about me.
Hey, don't mention it. Caring doesn't cost
a penny, after all! Heh heh heh...
(This young man lives with a dream...
If only I, too, had hope instead of battle...)
Oh! Who's that I see? Why, it's
note: name + #20 ', my good sir!' follows on the next line

en: You did come to see me in all my glory!
I'm touched! All right, today I'm going all out!
You're back again!
Hey,
...Or is just your name a bit too chummy?
<It's my work>
Unlike me, you're the brainy type, ha ha.
Oops... my bad. Guess I shouldn't have
asked, huh? I won't ask any more. Sorry.
But someday I'd love to make it big.
Oh, it's you. Yaaawn, so sleepy...
Wanna talk? Come to the main street square.
Oh,
Not that I've got anything. I'm broke!
! Look who it is!
note: name first: 'Chris! Look who it is!'

en: I'm glad you came.
You're welcome any time, so don't be shy.
Huh, it's you. Yaaawn
What's the matter, this late at night?
Jeremy, please. I need your help.
There's something I must do
What is it you need, anyway
Waaah! What are you-- Stop! Nooo!
I will make it up to you, Jeremy
, my master... What should I do?
